run_detail.final_report_markdown:
# Research report

Compare two opposing causal productivity results using these primary sources: Nature's Trip.com randomized trial 'Hybrid working from home improves retention without damaging performance' (https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-024-07500-2), which reports no performance damage, and Chicago BFI Working Paper 2021-56 'Work from Home & Productivity: Evidence from Personnel & Analytics Data on IT Professionals' (https://bfi.uchicago.edu/wp-content/uploads/2021/05/BFI_WP_2021-56.pdf), which reports an 8-19% productivity decline. Preserve the conflict and run one bounded counterfactual check.

**Outcome:** `INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE`

## Limitations

- `subject:implications`: REQUIRED_CELL_UNRESOLVED (`GAP`)
- `subject:key_evidence`: CONFLICT_REPAIR_EXHAUSTED (`CONFLICT_EXHAUSTED`)
- `subject:limitations`: REQUIRED_CELL_UNRESOLVED (`GAP`)
- EVIDENCE_CONFLICT
- CONFLICTED_CELL
- CONFLICT_REPAIR_EXHAUSTED

## Completion reasons

- INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE
- EVIDENCE_CONFLICT
- CONFLICTED_CELL
- CONFLICT_REPAIR_EXHAUSTED
